study.title: A Phase 3, Randomized Study of Dual Immunotherapy in Advanced NSCLC
study.headline: Forecast DBL delay: 6 days. Driven primarily by safety reconciliation (35%), delayed central laboratory transfer (30%), and ageing critical queries (22%).

primaryDrivers.summary: 2 unresolved SAE discrepancies at Site 104 blocking pharmacovigilance safety freeze.
Batch #LXB-8921 (ctDNA panel) checksum failure awaiting vendor QA re-export.
14 critical queries aged >14 days affecting RECIST tumor restaging at Sites 104 & 317.
18 case report books completed but awaiting PI electronic signatures.

dimensions.name: Safety Reconciliation
dimensions.details: 2 SAE discordances between Rave EDC (Form AE-02/DD-01) and Oracle Argus Safety at Site 104.

dimensions.name: External Data Readiness
dimensions.details: LabCorp ctDNA batch #LXB-8921 failed SHA-256 hash. Eurofins chemistry batch #LXB-8940 in sponsor QA review.

dimensions.name: Query Resolution
dimensions.details: 68 total open queries. 14 critical queries aged >14 days on RECIST 1.1 primary efficacy forms (SDTM.TU).

dimensions.name: SDV / SDR & Sign-offs
dimensions.details: SDV 93% complete. 18 completed casebooks awaiting 21 CFR Part 11 PI e-signatures (8 Site 104, 6 Site 405, 4 Site 317).

dimensions.name: Medical Coding
dimensions.details: MedDRA 27.0 and WHODrug Global C3 dictionary auto-coding running at 97.4%. 12 terms pending manual coder review.

dimensions.name: EDC Completeness
dimensions.details: 92% visits entered within 5-day protocol SLA. 12 non-critical eCRF forms pending site entry.

actions.title: Resolve 2 SAE discrepancies at Site 104
actions.rationale: 2 unresolved SAE discrepancies (Subjects 104-003, 104-012) blocking pharmacovigilance safety database freeze (35% of total DBL delay).
actions.proposedPlan: Conduct urgent joint safety review call with Boston Medical Center PI and pharmacovigilance physician.
actions.recommendation: Align Form AE-02 onset date (Oct 12) and upload hospice death certificate to Form DD-01 prior to safety freeze.
actions.proposedCommunication: Formal safety reconciliation packet to Site 104 PI & PV team.

actions.title: Escalate overdue LabCorp ctDNA transfer (#LXB-8921)
actions.rationale: ctDNA NGS batch #LXB-8921 failed SHA-256 checksum verification; transfer is 4 days past SLA (30% of total DBL delay).
actions.proposedPlan: Trigger Vendor SLA escalation protocol; ingest re-packaged FASTQ archive with verified SHA-256 manifest.
actions.recommendation: Escalate overdue central laboratory transfer with LabCorp Bioanalytical Geneva for expedited QA re-transmission.
actions.proposedCommunication: Vendor SLA formal escalation notice to LabCorp Account Executive.

actions.title: Prioritise 14 ageing RECIST primary endpoint queries
actions.action: Prioritise 14 ageing RECIST primary endpoint queries
actions.rationale: 14 critical queries aged >14 days affect RECIST 1.1 tumor restaging (SDTM.TU) for PFS primary endpoint analysis (22% of total DBL delay).
actions.proposedPlan: Arrange dedicated remote query-resolution sprint with Site 104 & Site 317 coordinators and BioClinica ICR.
actions.recommendation: Schedule focused radiology worksheet reconciliation session with site sub-investigators.
actions.affectedItems: 14 critical queries on Form TU-01 / TU-02
actions.proposedCommunication: Targeted query manifest to Site 104 & Site 317 Study Coordinators.

actions.title: Execute targeted CRA query-closure sprint at Site 208
actions.rationale: Site 208 has 41 open queries (38 routine SDTM.CM/DM clarifications, 3 secondary efficacy).
actions.proposedPlan: Deploy CRA monitor to assist site data coordinator for 2 business days prior to LSLV cut-off.
actions.recommendation: Clear high-volume non-critical query backlog at Site 208.
actions.proposedCommunication: On-site monitoring agenda and query batch export.

actions.title: Complete medical coding review for pivotal cohort
actions.rationale: 12 manual verbatim concomitant medication and adverse event terms awaiting Medical Coding Specialist sign-off.
actions.proposedPlan: Confirm MedDRA 27.0 and WHODrug Global C3 dictionary mappings for remaining 12 manual terms.
actions.recommendation: Complete medical coding review and lock dictionary tables before Coding Lock gate (11 Dec).
actions.proposedCommunication: Coding review queue assignment to Medical Reviewer.

actions.title: Obtain 18 pending PI 21 CFR Part 11 e-signatures
actions.rationale: 18 completed casebooks awaiting PI electronic signatures across Site 104 (8), Site 405 (6), and Site 317 (4) (13% of total DBL delay).
actions.proposedPlan: Dispatch 21 CFR Part 11 batch signing manifests and activate Sub-Investigator delegation at Site 405.
actions.recommendation: Execute scheduled PI signing clinics at Sites 104, 317, and 405.

actions.title: Reconcile Signant eCOA PRO diary sync lag
actions.action: Reconcile eCOA PRO diary sync lag
actions.rationale: 14 handheld patient PRO devices awaiting Cycle 6 transmission sync against 85% protocol threshold.
actions.proposedPlan: Trigger automated device sync push to active subjects and reconcile missing diary windows.
actions.recommendation: Complete eCOA PRO transmission reconciliation before vendor lock gate (05 Dec).

actions.title: Enforce 5-day query SLA across EU oncology sites
actions.rationale: Maintain query closure velocity above 4.0 queries/day heading into 30 Nov LSLV cut-off.
actions.proposedPlan: Auto-escalate queries unanswered after 72 hours during pre-lock window.
actions.recommendation: Enable pre-DBL automated 72h query reminder digest.

actions.title: Accelerate BioClinica central ICR adjudication (#IMG-44)
actions.rationale: Independent central radiology review (ICR) discordant reader pair awaiting third tie-breaker read.
actions.proposedPlan: Schedule urgent tie-breaker read session with BioClinica adjudication radiologist.
actions.recommendation: Lock central imaging read before vendor data lock gate (05 Dec).
actions.proposedCommunication: Priority adjudication request to ICR chair.

actions.title: Complete Form DD-01 death narrative SDV (Subj 104-012)
actions.action: Complete Form DD-01 death narrative SDV
actions.rationale: Primary cause of death recorded as Disease Progression in Rave EOS-01 vs Neutropenic Sepsis in Argus Safety.
actions.proposedPlan: Verify certified hospice discharge record on-site and reconcile Form DD-01 with Argus SUSAR narrative.
actions.recommendation: Align primary cause of death prior to safety freeze gate (08 Dec).
actions.proposedCommunication: Urgent medical clarification request to Site 104 PI.

actions.title: Reconcile Grade 3 AE grading discordance at Site 901
actions.rationale: CTCAE v5.0 severity grading discrepancy on immune-mediated pneumonitis event at MD Anderson (Site 901).
actions.proposedPlan: Review source pulmonary consult note with pharmacovigilance specialist.
actions.recommendation: Reconcile CTCAE grade in Form AE-02 prior to safety freeze.

actions.title: Execute Sub-I delegated signing clinic at Site 405
actions.rationale: PI on academic leave; delegated Sub-Investigator authorized on DoA log to sign the 6 completed casebooks at Site 405.
actions.proposedPlan: Verify Form FDA 1572 / DoA log in Veeva eTMF and complete 21 CFR Part 11 signatures for 6 casebooks.
actions.recommendation: Complete 6 overdue casebook e-signatures at Seoul National University Hospital (Site 405).
actions.proposedCommunication: e-Signature session invite to Site 405 Sub-Investigator.

interventions.title: Resolve 2 SAE reconciliation discrepancies (Site 104)

interventions.description: Execute SLA escalation with LabCorp Bioanalytical Geneva to ingest re-packaged ctDNA NGS batch (48 samples) with verified SHA-256 checksum.

interventions.title: Execute 21 CFR Part 11 PI e-signature clinics (18 casebooks)
interventions.description: Activate Sub-Investigator DoA delegation at Site 405 (6 casebooks) and complete batch PI signing sessions at Site 104 (8) and Site 317 (4).

interventions.title: Lock MedDRA 27.0 & WHODrug C3 coding queues
interventions.description: Complete manual medical coder verification for the remaining 12 uncoded concomitant medication and adverse event verbatim terms.

forecastScenarios.assumptions: Critical interventions (SAE recon + LabCorp transfer) executed within 48 hours. Zero new SAE reports emerging post-LSLV. Query closure velocity hits 4.2/day across all sites.
Current team velocity continues. SAE discrepancy resolved by Nov 03. LabCorp transfer ingested Nov 02. Minor routine queries burn down within 7 days.
Site 104 PI unavailable during Thanksgiving week. Vendor transfer fails second checksum verification. Secondary RECIST adjudication requires scan repeat.

Vendor SLA escalation protocol expedited batch checksum verification by 14 hours; vendor response coefficient updated for LabCorp.
